title: Regulating Taxis, Milk, & City Hospital Needs
summary:
*   The city actively regulated new services and essential goods, approving many licenses for "service car" drivers (like early taxis) and businesses selling milk.
*   Plans to repair the "Old Hospital" building were endorsed, showing the city's commitment to healthcare infrastructure.
*   A small amount ($50) was reallocated from the sanitary sewer fund to cover miscellaneous city expenses.
